intro: Choose what your home page shows. Any field you leave empty uses the theme’s own text or photo, so fill in only what you’d like to change. The grey text in an empty field is what the site shows.
classicNote: Your site’s current theme shows only the welcome line and the workshops. The parts on this page appear with a theme that has them.
hidden: This part is hidden: visitors don’t see it.
photoHint: Leave it empty to use the theme’s own photo.
unsaved: You have changes that aren’t saved yet.

hero.title: Top of the page
hero.description: The first thing visitors see: a big photo or video with your headline and a button to the workshops.

theme.title: The theme’s photos
theme.hint: Ready-made photos that come with the theme.

images.title: My photos
images.hint: Up to {max, number} photos, shown one after another.

video.title: A video
video.hint: A short video that plays silently, over and over.

hero.photosHint: Wide (landscape) photos look best. The first one shows first; drag them or use the arrows to change the order.
hero.videoHint: A short clip of {min, number} to {max, number} seconds loads fastest. A MOV video from an iPhone needs to be saved as MP4 first.
hero.posterHint: Shown while the video loads. Optional.
hero.heading: Headline
hero.subtitle: Line under the headline
hero.buttonHint: The button opens the list of workshops.

story.title: Our story
story.description: A photo with a few warm sentences about you, and a button to the upcoming workshops.
story.heading: Title
story.textHint: A few sentences, up to {max, number} characters.

crafts.title: Explore by craft
crafts.description: A photo with a button for each kind of workshop (candles, ceramics…). It appears when there are open workshops.
crafts.heading: Title

past.title: Past workshops
past.description: Photos from workshops that have ended. It appears once there are some.
past.heading: Title

steps.title: How it works
steps.description: Up to {max, number} short steps over a photo, telling visitors how to join a workshop.
steps.heading: Title

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: The bottom of every page: a few words about you and how to reach you. Contact fields left empty are not shown.
footer.instagramHint: Copy it from your Instagram profile, for example https://instagram.com/yourname
footer.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +90 555 123 45 67

errors.photosNeeded: Add at least one photo, or choose another background.
errors.videoNeeded: Add a video, or choose another background.
errors.instagram: Please paste your Instagram page’s address, for example https://instagram.com/yourname
errors.phone: Please write the phone number with digits only, for example +90 555 123 45 67
